issues.title: [Epic · Week 2] Web skeleton, UI system, and synthetic catalog foundation
issues.outcome: Deliver a deployable application skeleton and reusable UI/data foundations using only synthetic content.
acceptanceCriteria: Shell, design system, synthetic catalog loader, quality gate, and placeholder pipeline are integrated.
No real Arcaea data or protected asset is present.
A production build renders representative synthetic states.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · Engineering] One-command quality gate for web, synthetic data, Rust/WASM, and production build
issues.outcome: Provide one reproducible command and CI gate for the synthetic-first web MVP and preserved Rust workspace.
scope: Formatting, linting, types, tests, schema/content validation, Rust checks, production build, and smoke tests.
Fail on synthetic-policy violations and protected-content fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean checkout passes the command.
CI is least privilege and pinned.
Synthetic content validation runs before build.
Public bundles exclude runtime/debug fixtures.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · Frontend] Migrate the web app from Vite to Rsbuild/Rspack
issues.outcome: Move the public web build to Rsbuild/Rspack while preserving React, TypeScript, tests, base paths, and Rust/WASM isolation.
scope: Migration ADR, scripts/configuration, production base path, baseline measurements, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Development, tests, and production build pass.
No Vite-only public path remains.
Bundle evidence is captured.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · UX] Implement accessible light/dark design foundations
issues.outcome: Translate the approved original direction into reusable neutral tokens and primitives that remain complete without game media.
scope: Semantic light/dark/system tokens, typography, spacing, focus, navigation, forms, cards, tables, filters, provenance, spoiler, and placeholder states.
Document component APIs and misuse cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Both themes meet contrast targets.
Core primitives render with long/missing/synthetic data.
Reduced motion and high zoom remain usable.
No official-game or copied-wiki UI asset is used.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · Frontend] Build app shell, routing, theme, settings, and resilient route states
issues.outcome: Replace the debug screen with a generic, production-quality knowledge-base shell that can host synthetic pages before authorization.
scope: Header, footer, navigation, skip link, route layout, settings, 404, loading, empty, offline, error, and preview-status surfaces.
Hide runtime/viewer routes from the public entry.
acceptanceCriteria: All planned routes resolve to intentional synthetic or unavailable states.
Keyboard and focus behavior are tested.
Theme switching avoids flash.
Direct navigation works under the selected preview strategy.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · Data] Implement validated synthetic catalog loading, indexes, and failure states
issues.outcome: Load versioned synthetic records through a typed repository adapter and generated static artifacts.
scope: Schema validation, reference integrity, generated search/filter indexes, catalog manifest/checksums, compatibility, stale/corrupt/missing states, and adapter tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid data fails CI.
Route code receives typed view models through the adapter.
Catalog version and synthetic status are visible.
No network database is required.
A future approved-source adapter can replace the synthetic implementation without route rewrites.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 2 · Assets] Build original placeholder and permission-aware media pipeline
issues.outcome: Create a deterministic media pipeline using project-authored synthetic placeholders now and permission-approved assets only after authorization.
scope: Asset manifest, authorship/permission records, checksums, duplicate detection, responsive variants, dimensions, file-size budgets, alt decisions, and missing-media behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Every synthetic preview asset has an authorship or compatible-license record.
Build rejects unknown permission status.
No official or extracted Arcaea media is required.
Pages reserve dimensions and remain complete without media.
The same pipeline can later process only explicitly approved assets.
definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria are verified.
Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.
